Helen,

For PO-8840 we need 240 x 4 L bottles of HPLC gradient-grade acetonitrile (your cat. SW-ACN-4LG), delivered to Corvid Bio, 88 Harbor Rd receiving, by Fri Dec 4. Three questions:
